note: ZERO-TOLERANCE GATE (owner ruling, 2026-11-05): the DRC step asserts ZERO violations and ZERO unconnected items. Any nonzero count fails CI. This retires the ratchet baseline (726 violations / 190 unconnected, calibrated 2026-11-03 to the worst early board, plus jitter tolerances of 5/2): that scheme reported a lump-sum total with no per-class accounting, so whole defect classes — including courtyard overlaps, i.e. components physically stacked on each other — sat inside the total while the gate stayed green. A red run over an unfinished board is the correct signal; the site build is decoupled from this gate and keeps publishing with the counts shown as board state. The 0/0 end-state guard in scripts/drc_gate.py (tolerances ignored at 0/0) is the mechanism: no code change was needed, only this file's values. PINNED EXCLUSIONS (2026-11-11): drc_exclusions pins the four J1 copper_edge_clearance items (Amphenol 12401610E4-2A land pattern: shell stakes + mounting hole at the board edge by design). The identical list lives in hw/pdlvds_rx.kicad_pro board.design_settings.drc_exclusions; scripts/drc_gate.py fails loudly if the two lists differ, if an exclusion matches no report item, or if any non-excluded violation appears.
